cookies.title: Your privacy, your choice
cookies.body: We use essential cookies to run Nawy. With your OK we'd also use analytics and personalisation cookies to improve the store. Nothing optional is on until you choose.
cookies.necessaryHint: Sign-in, cart, checkout, security. Always on.
cookies.analyticsHint: Anonymous usage stats to fix bugs and speed up pages.
cookies.personalisationHint: Recommendations based on what you browse on Nawy.
cookies.advertisingHint: Measure ads and show relevant offers on other sites.
cookies.note: Choices are saved for 6 months and can be changed any time from the footer “Cookie settings”.
